senses.gloss: to sign up, to join in
senses.example: Me he apuntado al gimnasio del barrio.
senses.exampleGloss: I have signed up to the local gym.

alternatives.reason: More formal, often for courses or races.
The non-reflexive sense: noting something down.

notes: apuntarse a algo = to sign up for something. Very common Peninsular everyday verb.
